notes.title: High Score Leaderboard among other updates for Xylith - Hostile Planet
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36857016/4b638a7ab7eeb6a1653d9d58502eb5be8df9ae6a.png[/img]

[h1]Major Patch Notes:[/h1]

[list]
[*] All New Leaderboard in addition to Achievements.
[*] Major improvement to Control Scheme
[*] Major Improvements to Game Performance 
[*](Removed Instagram style filters to gain massive performance boost.)
[*] Major Bugfixes for Utility Frames
[*] Added New Perk Dropdown when you launch a new game.
[*] Added new Screen to name your character.
[*] Added MySQL Database to store High-scores.  This integrates with Itch-io and Steam Versions
[*] Steam Version continues to offer the most features with Steam Achievements 
[*] We have increased the dig speed. (You can now get around and mine much faster.)
[*] Fixed the mouse toggle mode 1 issues.   This is a feature for playing 100% on the controller that was broken in the last release. ​
[/list]

Thanks for playing all. As a solo dev it is great to see so many people playing.
-Gillis

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36857016/71fceb96ff559e7ee0caa44748bf76493867078d.png[/img]
